sections.changelog: 3.0.0-alpha.19: Nested Mobile Edge Parity + VDM Admin Menu Sort. Mobile V1 full-width rules now traverse nested Section/Container hierarchy; hero/tagline and major bands get correct mobile edge treatment, nested spacers are suppressed, VDM admin submenu is alphabetized, and the unintended Designer palette sort is removed.
